exposure: oxytocin administration following prelabor rupture of membranes (PROM)
Oxytocin administration following prelabor rupture of membranes (PROM)
outcome: Composite of uterine rupture and postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 363 women with no prior vaginal delivery undergoing IOL for LAC
finding: All examined IOL methods with an unfavorable cervix carried similar rates of LAC success, uterine rupture, postpartum hemorrhage, and composite adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The success rates of labor after cesarean were comparable across different induction methods (oxytocin after prelabor rupture of membranes, oxytocin only, extra-amniotic balloon, and amniotomy).
